findings: The inner and outer rear caps surround the complete driving-wheel bearing footprints. The front/rear panel seam remains at its previous calibrated X station; the source identities of the inner geometric slots are corrected.

The revised lower border continues level rearward and meets the rising hull outline, preserving a single lower skirt. A prior return to the original high rear control left an invalid or disconnected skirt and was rejected.

The oblique rear section crop exposes the outer nut, locking plate, six bearing screws and backing-plate rivets. Lower-border position, detailed casting and fastener placement remain inferred; the view is diagnostic, not a pose variant.
